# 2. Methods

## 2.1 Vegetation Assessment

Field vegetation data were collected using standard plot-based methodology and classified
according to the Wetland Assessment and Impact Rating (WAIR) framework and the Alberta
Native Plant Council (ANPC) Wetland Plant Communities classification system.

## 2.2 Soils Assessment

Soil profiles were described and classified following the Canadian System of Soil
Classification (CSSC). Peat layers were characterized using the Von Post humification scale.

## 2.3 Water Permanence

Historical water permanence was assessed from multi-date satellite imagery using NDWI
pixel classification, supplemented by LiDAR-derived topographic analysis.

## 3.4 Peat Resources

```{r}
#| label: setup-peat
#| include: false
peat_field_csv <- here("data-raw", paste0(params$project_id, "_peat_field_summary.csv"))
peat_unc_rds   <- here("data-raw", paste0(params$project_id, "_peat_uncertainty.rds"))
has_peat <- file.exists(peat_field_csv) && file.exists(peat_unc_rds)
```

```{r}
#| label: peat-placeholder
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr "!has_peat"
cat("*[No peat module outputs found for `", params$project_id,
    "` — run analysis/peat/ steps 01–05 to populate this section.]*", sep = "")
```

Per-hole field measurements — AWCS wetland class, dominant surface bryophyte,
peat depth, depth to water table, pH, electrical conductivity, and harvestable
thickness by product grade — are summarised below. Net harvestable peat volumes,
split into professional (H1–H4) and retail (H5–H6) grades with a bootstrap
sampling-uncertainty interval, follow. The professional and retail thickness
surfaces are mapped beneath the tables.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-peat-field
#| tbl-cap: "Per-hole field summary. Harvestable thicknesses are net of the 0.5 m basal reclamation allowance; “—” = not recorded (e.g. frozen ground) or not applicable (Upland anchor)."
#| eval: !expr has_peat
knitr::kable(read.csv(peat_field_csv, check.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-peat-harvestable
#| tbl-cap: "Net harvestable peat by product grade, with a 90% bootstrap interval (sampling uncertainty) on the harvestable rows."
#| eval: !expr has_peat
knitr::kable(readRDS(peat_unc_rds)$headline, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: note-peat-harvestable
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr has_peat
cat(readRDS(peat_unc_rds)$note)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-peat-professional
#| fig-cap: "Professional-grade (H1–H4) harvestable peat thickness."
#| eval: !expr has_peat
knitr::include_graphics(here(params$figure_dir, paste0(params$project_id, "_map_professional.png")))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-peat-retail
#| fig-cap: "Retail-grade (H5–H6) harvestable peat thickness."
#| eval: !expr has_peat
knitr::include_graphics(here(params$figure_dir, paste0(params$project_id, "_map_retail.png")))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-peat-bootstrap
#| fig-cap: "Bootstrap distribution of harvestable volume, reflecting sampling uncertainty from the limited number of test holes."
#| eval: !expr has_peat
knitr::include_graphics(here(params$figure_dir, paste0(params$project_id, "_peat_bootstrap.png")))
```
